verdict.rationale: The evidence only says LegalZoom offers access to 150+ customizable legal documents. None of it names offer letters, confidentiality/IP assignment agreements, or option grants, and nothing shows a workflow for running hiring or equity paperwork. The mention that corporations can offer stock to investors is about choosing an entity type, not about issuing option grants through the platform.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform
